note: 2026-09-27 Unit 7 rebuild (user direction: rebuild Units 5-7 through the engine, new photos approved). Learn holds the six weather words alone (It is is known). It is ... practises each one; the two-feature photos change only one word (hot and sunny, cold and sunny, hot and cloudy), and today and in the morning come back in Speak and Use.

lesson.title: 7.4 Weather
lesson.unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson.lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.goal: Recognize six kinds of weather and say what the weather is like today or in the morning.
lesson.grammar_function: It is sunny. It is hot and sunny. It is cold in the morning.
lesson.prerequisite: 2.3 it is; 2.9 and; 4.5 in the morning; 4.9 today.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say what the weather is like.
